id: work-redcomm
Mengembangkan dan memelihara aplikasi web internal menggunakan Laravel, Nuxt.js, Docker, MySQL, dan Redis.
Mengimplementasikan antarmuka pengguna yang responsif dan fungsionalitas backend sesuai kebutuhan bisnis dan stakeholder.
Berkolaborasi dengan tim pengembang melalui alur kerja berbasis Git dan proses deployment internal.
en: Develop and maintain internal web applications using Laravel, Nuxt.js, Docker, MySQL, and Redis.
Implement responsive user interfaces and backend functionalities based on business requirements and stakeholder needs.
Collaborate with development teams through Git-based workflows and internal deployment processes.

id: work-ziggs
Memelihara dan meningkatkan aplikasi web produksi Ziggs.id melalui peningkatan fitur, perbaikan bug, dan dukungan teknis berkelanjutan.
Mengelola deployment produksi dan tugas operasional pada Linux VPS, termasuk akses server via SSH, health check aplikasi, dan manajemen layanan PHP-FPM.
Mengimplementasikan dan memelihara workflow CI/CD otomatis dengan GitHub Actions untuk mempermudah deployment dari repository ke server produksi.
Melakukan troubleshooting produksi dan maintenance aplikasi Laravel untuk meningkatkan keandalan deployment dan ketersediaan layanan.
en: Maintain and enhance Ziggs.id's production web application through ongoing feature improvements, bug fixes, and technical support.
Manage production deployment and operational tasks on a Linux VPS, including SSH-based server access, application health checks, and PHP-FPM service management.
Implement and maintain automated CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions to streamline application deployment from the repository to the production server.
Perform production troubleshooting and Laravel application maintenance to improve deployment reliability and service availability.

id: work-web-developer
Mengembangkan dan menyerahkan aplikasi web responsif sesuai kebutuhan klien.
Memberikan konsultasi teknis, implementasi, dan pemeliharaan website secara berkelanjutan.
en: Develop and deliver responsive web applications tailored to client requirements.
Provide technical consultation, implementation, and ongoing website maintenance.

id: work-aslab
Mendampingi sesi praktikum Sistem Digital, Sistem Basis Data, dan Pemrograman Berorientasi Objek, membimbing mahasiswa memahami konsep teknis melalui latihan langsung.
Mengoordinasikan kegiatan laboratorium dan membantu sesama asisten dalam menyiapkan materi, menilai tugas, dan menyelesaikan kendala teknis.
en: Assisted practical laboratory sessions in Digital Systems, Database Systems, and Object-Oriented Programming, guiding students through technical concepts and hands-on exercises.
Coordinated laboratory activities and supported fellow teaching assistants in preparing learning materials, evaluating assignments, and resolving technical issues.

id: org-hmif-saintek
Memfasilitasi pengembangan akademik dan teknis mahasiswa Informatika melalui program kerja workshop, kelompok belajar, dan seminar teknologi.
Mengelola dan mengkurasi informasi mengenai kompetisi teknologi tingkat nasional (seperti GEMASTIK dan PKM) guna mendorong partisipasi dan prestasi mahasiswa.
Berkolaborasi menyelenggarakan 'Soedirman Technophoria', ajang nasional yang mencakup kompetisi web development dan seminar teknologi masa kini.
en: Facilitated the academic and technical development of Informatics students through work programs such as workshops, study groups, and technology seminars.
Managed and curated information regarding national-level tech competitions (such as GEMASTIK and PKM) to encourage student participation and achievement.
Collaborated in organizing 'Soedirman Technophoria', a national-level event featuring web development competitions and seminars to introduce emerging technologies to the public.

id: org-ssdc
Memimpin komunitas developer mahasiswa yang berfokus menciptakan iklim belajar kolaboratif dalam software engineering dan pemrograman.
Membentuk forum diskusi dan sesi studi rutin untuk memfasilitasi pertukaran wawasan terkait tech stack modern dan best practice industri.
Mengkoordinasikan keikutsertaan anggota dalam hackathon dan kompetisi coding, serta mengarahkan proyek open-source kolaboratif.
en: Led a student developer community focused on fostering a collaborative learning environment for software engineering and programming.
Established regular discussion forums and study sessions to facilitate knowledge sharing on modern tech stacks and best practices.
Coordinated member participation in hackathons and coding competitions, while also overseeing collaborative open-source projects to build practical portfolios.

en: Supported on-site event operations and coordination to ensure smooth execution of the pilot program.
